component_version_name: P03 passive sweep; distinct from parent gainpilot P03 which does not load this plugin

numeric_profile.name: astra_p03_engineering_numeric_v1
numeric_profile.interpretation: conservative engineering envelope tested against high-precision and independent references in this bounded domain; not a formal floating-point proof

tests.fixture_limits: Synthetic metadata/audit documents test code paths only; no empirical P03 Gazebo evidence or release authority.

runtime_facts: BeforePhysicsUpdate and WorldUpdateEnd WorldState messages use the same already-advanced source stamp.
Each phase reads actual public ODE body rotation mode/axis, kinematic/auto-disable/damping settings and enabled state.
Native dBodyGetMass mass/COM/inertia, native body COM/quaternion, and Gazebo merged inertial/actual collision primitives are retained.
Native COM/quaternion are checked against link pose and merged COM; configuration revision must remain constant through the evaluation interval.
No physics setters, command publishers, ROS subscriptions/services, hashing or filesystem I/O in the observer.

bound.normal_extension: COM linear in unit phase; quaternion normalized normal-Euler extension. Endpoint post-damping/ERP velocities are not a speed bound.
bound.robot_step: max_i solver_B_i + max_i previous_End_to_Pre_variation_i; maxima are separate because critical bodies can differ.
bound.actor_step: sum reviewed source-rule max(current/target speed)*dt budgets for Begin jumps, plus explicit translation/rotation phase tolerance budgets.
bound.coarse: P=sum all exact 2ms robot+obstacle variation budgets; lower=min(d0,d1)-10um-P/2, with 0.33m margin already subtracted from endpoint geometry.
bound.geometry: Actual runtime compound box eight-corner and outer48-gon cylinder projections; Z screen diagnostic. Robot mass/COM/body roster/collision count/radius also checked against saved expanded URDF in CLI.
bound.qualification_limit: A bounded engineer-reviewed Gazebo algorithmic extension and actor discrete paths; not real continuous physical safety or formal floating point verification.

required_root_integration: After active gainpilot terminates, independently review these exact new source hashes; add isolated CMake library target astra_physics_metadata_p03_plugin using catkin/Gazebo libs and current generated gazebo_msgs.
Load libastra_physics_metadata_p03_plugin.so once as a world plugin in a separately named future environment stage; it does not replace the whole-system contact plugin.
Record all six P03 topics plus existing whole-system contacts and task/input evidence; recorder ready before evaluated policy window; never backfill P01/P02/gainpilot.
Archive exact expanded runtime robot_description and actual world; collect process maps with SHA copies of loaded ODE/Gazebo/controller/actor/observer libraries.

Produce separately reviewed run closure covering authorized isolated-master node roster, launch and source/binary identities, service-call audit, engine-source/native-test correspondence, and all robot/actor pose writers.

Execute a fresh common-environment qualification with known positive/negative obstacle/rotation/actor probes, verify lossless2ms Pre/End/status coverage, metadata stable revision, native-body consistency and acceptable simulation throughput.
Pass exact source window endpoints to offline CLI; combine its engine-scope clearance with existing contacts, input integrity, mask and failure-inclusive task assessment.
